title: The Water Cycle
summary: Follow a drop of water as it rises, becomes a cloud, falls as rain and runs back to the sea.

steps.title: The Sun heats water
sentences: The Sun warms the water in oceans, rivers and puddles.
Some of the water turns into an invisible gas called water vapour and rises into the air.

steps.title: Clouds form
sentences: High up, the air is cold.
The water vapour cools down and turns back into tiny drops of water.
Millions of drops together make a cloud. This is called condensation.

steps.title: Rain falls
sentences: When the drops in a cloud get big and heavy, they fall as rain.
In very cold places they fall as snow or hail.

steps.title: Back to the sea
sentences: Rain runs down hills into streams and rivers, and flows back to the sea.
Some soaks into the ground and becomes groundwater.
Then the Sun warms it again, and the cycle goes on and on.
points: Rivers carry water to the sea

facts: The water you drink today may be the same water that dinosaurs drank, it just keeps going round.
About 97 percent of Earth's water is salty ocean water.
A fluffy cloud can weigh as much as about a hundred elephants, held up by the rising air.

quiz.q: What is it called when water turns into vapour?
quiz.why: Evaporation is water changing to vapour.
A cloud is millions of tiny water drops or ice crystals.

quiz.q: Which word means rain, snow or hail falling?
quiz.why: Precipitation is water falling from clouds.
